scope: raw directed topology with explicit PIP identity; not yet a design-qualified router or existing HLS kernel ABI

header.crc: CRC-64/ECMA-182, polynomial 0x42f0e1eba9ea3693, initial 0, non-reflected, xorout 0; payload only
header.architecture_hash: first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of canonical sorted compact JSON {schema,nodes_sha256,pips_sha256}; complete hash and descriptor in manifest

offsets.bin.record: u64 arc offset; first=0, monotonic, last=arc_count

arcs.bin.ordering: each source slice sorted by destination then edge_key; parallel PIPs retained

edge_key.direction_0: raw PIP start node -> raw end node
edge_key.direction_1: raw PIP end node -> raw start node
edge_key.limit: PIP count <= 2^31; reject larger catalogs before packing
edge_key.coverage: one declared direction for unidirectional PIPs, both directions for bidirectional PIPs; retain route-throughs; omit and enumerate missing-endpoint PIPs

protection_bits.1: at least one excluded/background net owner
protection_bits.4: native node tied to GND or VCC
protection_bits.8: native member getter empty; exhaustive membership retained separately

limitations: Protection is metadata until enforced by the routing controller
Core routing tile, clock, site-pin access and route-through admissibility are not established by CSR membership
No capacity, base cost or delay is fabricated
CSR storage excludes raw native lookup catalogs, geometry, mutable state, route trees, tasks and hardware queues; storage size alone is not HBM feasibility or performance evidence
